content: To begin securing your account, we’ll need to use the ShieldGuard app. Are you ready to proceed with the setup process?
Yes, I’m ready. What should I do first?
First, make sure you have your mobile phone handy. We’ll be installing ShieldGuard, which will protect your information.
Okay, I have my phone here. Where do I get ShieldGuard?
Great. Open your phone’s app store—either Google Play or the Apple App Store—so we can begin the download.
I’m on the app store now. Should I just search for ShieldGuard?
Exactly. Please type 'ShieldGuard Security' into the search bar and look for the app with the blue shield icon.
I see it. It says ShieldGuard Security with a blue shield. Is that the right one?
Yes, that's the correct app. Now, tap 'Download' or 'Get' to start downloading it to your device.
It’s downloading now.
Perfect. Wait for the download to finish, then tap 'Open' to launch ShieldGuard.
Alright, it's installed and I’ve opened it.
Good job. When prompted, grant the necessary permissions so the app can secure your account properly.
It’s asking for access to my notifications and storage. Should I allow that?
Yes, allow those permissions to ensure ShieldGuard can monitor and protect your device effectively.
Done. It’s now asking me to sign in or register. What do I do?
Select 'Register' and create a new account using your preferred email address. This will complete the app setup.
I’ve entered my email and created a password.
Excellent. Tap 'Submit' to finish registration. Afterward, make sure to verify your email if prompted.
It sent me a verification link. I’ve clicked it.
Great. Once you’re verified, log back into the ShieldGuard app to finalize the process.
I’m logged in now. Is there anything else I need to do?
For full protection, enable real-time monitoring and automatic scans within the app settings.
I turned both options on.
Perfect. Your account and device are now protected with ShieldGuard. If you need further assistance, let me know.
